run_actuatornet_training: run the actuatornet Keras model training on a CSV dataset with motor position, speed, action, and torque data
build_sequential_model: build a Keras Sequential model with Dense layers using relu, sigmoid, and linear activations for regression
create_model_checkpoint: create a ModelCheckpoint callback that saves the best model weights based on validation loss
train_model_with_validation: train the Keras model for 4500 epochs with a 34 percent validation split and batch size of 1024
evaluate_model_scores: evaluate the trained Keras model and print the mean squared error metric as a percentage
